zh: 新增「启动直达页面」：设置 → 通用里能选打开应用先落到哪一页（课表 / 今日 / 课表管理 / 备忘录 / 我的）。
当前选项就显示在这一行的标题上，点开是单选列表，选完即时保存，下次冷启动直接到位。
出厂默认仍是课表，与旧版行为一致；「恢复默认设置」会把它一起还原。
教务导入的学校仍是 388 所（上一版扩量）。
en: New "Launch page": under Settings → General, pick which tab the app opens on (Schedule / Today / Manage / Memo / Mine).
The current choice is shown as the row title; tapping opens a single-choice list that saves immediately and applies on the next cold start.
The default is still Schedule, matching previous behaviour, and "Reset all settings" restores it.
School presets remain at 388 from the previous release.

zh: 周视图组件与应用内课表对齐：行数按课表全部节次渲染，13 节课表不再少画最后一节
课程块按节次号查表定位，删过节次的课表也不再整列错位
非常规时间的课按真实分钟比例摆放，起点与高度和应用内一致
课程卡圆角改用与应用内同一个设置（不再写死 4dp）
卡片太矮时不再给教室留位置，课名不再被挤成“综合实…”
en: Week widget now shares the in-app geometry: rows follow the whole period table, so a 13-period week no longer loses its last row
Courses are placed by looking up their period node instead of subtracting one, so tables with deleted periods stay aligned
Irregular-time courses use real-minute fractions, matching their start and height in the app
Course cards take the same corner radius as the in-app grid instead of a hardcoded 4dp
Short cards no longer reserve a room line, so the course name is not squeezed into an ellipsis
